_comment: Daily town events and weekend festivals in Adventure mode (game words are fine). Every line is listed in docs/voice-lines.md beside its trigger. Placeholders filled by the app: {gives} {receives} {building} {count} {quietDays} {logged} {more} {festival} {reward}. The short-shift lines frame quiet days as the town working harder when the ledger is kept, never as a loss. An event is always a treat, never a test: taking it is a choice and waving it off costs nothing. A missing key falls back to the built-in line.
trader.1: A travelling trader sets up by the well. Swap {gives} for {receives}?
trader.2: A cart rolls in with just what the yard is short of: {receives} for {gives}.
trader.3: A merchant tips her hat. "I'll take {gives} off your hands for {receives}."
windfall.1: The {building} crew is in fine form today: {receives} extra, ready to bring in.
windfall.2: A lucky find at the {building}! {receives} waiting to be stacked.
windfall.3: The {building} had a cracking morning. {receives} more for the stores.
visitor.1: An old friend stops by with a gift: {receives}.
visitor.2: A neighbour leaves a parcel at your door: {receives}.
visitor.3: A wandering bard pays for supper with {receives}.
festival.marketDay: It's market day! Stalls line the square and the whole town turns out.
festival.fair: A fair fills the square this weekend. The town is in high spirits after a well-kept week.
festival.grandFestival: A grand festival! Lanterns, music and dancing: every weekday kept, and the whole town celebrates.
festival.joint: The whole party kept the week together, and the festival is all the merrier for it.
festival.claimed: Its gifts are already in your stores.
away.title: While you were away
away.fullDays: Full days: the ledger was kept.
away.shortShifts: Short shifts on {quietDays}. Log today and the crews work the full day.
away.shortShiftsLogged: Short shifts on {quietDays}. Today is logged, so the crews are on the full day.
tag.openTown: Log today to open the town
spirit.title: Town spirit
spirit.weekday: Every weekday you log lifts the town. So far the weekend holds a {festival}.
spirit.weekend: The weekend is here and the {festival} is on!
